form.label: RentHub Service Health
form.description: Logs (renthub_logs), business events (renthub_events) and JVM metrics (renthub_metrics) for the RentHub microservices. See docs/SPLUNK_GUIDE.md for the SPL behind every panel.

input.label: Filter by service (click a bar below to set this too)

search.query: index=renthub_logs OR index=renthub_events | timechart span=1m count by service
index=renthub_logs service=$svc_filter$ | timechart span=1m count(eval(level="ERROR")) as errors count as total | eval error_pct=round(errors/total*100,2) | fields _time error_pct
index=renthub_logs level=ERROR service=$svc_filter$ | top limit=10 message service
`renthub_by_service("user-service")` index=renthub_events type=user_login_failure | timechart span=5m count by username

panel.title: Trace one request across every service (requestId=$requestId$)

search.query: (index=renthub_logs OR index=renthub_events) requestId=$requestId$ | eval time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%3N") | table time index service level type message status durationMs requestId | sort time

panel.title: JVM heap used by service (renthub_metrics, mstats)

search.query: | mstats avg("jvm.memory.heap.used") as heap_used_bytes WHERE index=renthub_metrics span=1m BY service
| mstats latest("http.request.count") as requests latest("http.error.count") as errors WHERE index=renthub_metrics BY service
